entities.name: Église Notre-Dame-de-la-Salette de Paris
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Notre-Dame-de-la-Salette is a Roman Catholic church located rue de Cronstadt in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. It is under the patronage of Our Lady of La Salette, particularly revered by the religious congregation of St. Vincent de Paul.
